name: 0001_initial.sql
statements:
CREATE TABLE servers (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  url TEXT NOT NULL,
  version TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'v3',
  kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'panel',
  auth TEXT NOT NULL,
  credentials TEXT NOT NULL,
  location TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  subscription_url TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE health (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  server_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES servers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  timestamp INTEGER NOT NULL,
  online INTEGER NOT NULL,
  latency INTEGER NOT NULL,
  snapshot TEXT,
  error TEXT
)
CREATE INDEX health_server_time ON health(server_id, timestamp DESC)

CREATE TABLE audit (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  timestamp INTEGER NOT NULL,
  actor TEXT NOT NULL,
  server_id TEXT,
  action TEXT NOT NULL,
  success INTEGER NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX audit_time ON audit(timestamp DESC)

CREATE TABLE login_limits (
  key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  attempts INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expires INTEGER NOT NULL
)

name: 0002_services.sql
statements:
CREATE TABLE server_policy (
  server_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES servers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  data TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE tunnels (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  source_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES servers(id),
  target_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES servers(id),
  state TEXT NOT NULL,
  data TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

name: 0003_subscriptions.sql
statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS subscriptions (server_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES servers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, email TEXT NOT NULL, token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, secret TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(server_id, email))

name: 0004_locations.sql
statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS locations (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, server_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES servers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, name TEXT NOT NULL, provider TEXT NOT NULL, country TEXT NOT NULL, secret TEXT NOT NULL, tested_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, delay INTEGER, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

name: 0005_subscription_identity.sql
statements: ALTER TABLE subscriptions ADD COLUMN identity TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''

name: 0006_telegram_store.sql
statements:
CREATE TABLE telegram_store (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
  config TEXT NOT NULL, secrets TEXT NOT NULL, username TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  webhook TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', connected INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
)

CREATE TABLE telegram_orders (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, update_key INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  product_name TEXT NOT NULL, amount INTEGER NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, paid_at INTEGER, email TEXT NOT NULL, error TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  snapshot TEXT NOT NULL, provision TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', delivery TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  charge_id TEXT UNIQUE, lease_until INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
)
CREATE INDEX telegram_orders_work ON telegram_orders(status, lease_until)
CREATE INDEX telegram_orders_customer ON telegram_orders(user_id, created_at)
CREATE TABLE telegram_updates (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, payload TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', lease_until INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

name: 0007_store_transfers.sql
statements: ALTER TABLE telegram_orders ADD COLUMN currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'XTR'
ALTER TABLE telegram_orders ADD COLUMN payment_method TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'stars'
ALTER TABLE telegram_orders ADD COLUMN receipt TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
ALTER TABLE telegram_orders ADD COLUMN reviewed_by TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
ALTER TABLE telegram_orders ADD COLUMN reviewed_at INTEGER
ALTER TABLE telegram_orders ADD COLUMN receipt_notified INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
ALTER TABLE telegram_orders ADD COLUMN receipt_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
CREATE TABLE telegram_receipt_sessions (user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES telegram_orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

name: 0008_bootstrap.sql
statements:
CREATE TABLE bootstrap_jobs (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, server_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES servers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  state TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

name: 0009_managed_panels.sql
statements: ALTER TABLE servers ADD COLUMN parent_id TEXT REFERENCES servers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_managed_panel_per_server ON servers(parent_id) WHERE parent_id IS NOT NULL

name: 0010_control_plane.sql
statements:
CREATE TABLE managed_state (
  server_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES servers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  document TEXT NOT NULL,
  applied_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  phase TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  error TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  checked_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  lease TEXT,
  lease_until INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  bound INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
)

CREATE TABLE managed_versions (
  server_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES servers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
  document TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (server_id, revision)
)

CREATE TABLE replacements (
  server_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES servers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES servers(id),
  state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'installing',
  error TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE fleet_inbounds (
  id TEXT NOT NULL,
  server_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES servers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  inbound_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id, server_id)
)

name: 0011_tunnel_sync.sql
statements: ALTER TABLE tunnels ADD COLUMN desired_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'configured'
ALTER TABLE tunnels ADD COLUMN lease TEXT
ALTER TABLE tunnels ADD COLUMN lease_until INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
ALTER TABLE tunnels ADD COLUMN error TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
UPDATE tunnels SET desired_state='removed' WHERE state IN ('removed','removing','cleanup-required')
CREATE INDEX tunnels_sync ON tunnels(desired_state,state,updated_at)

name: 0012_replacement_sync.sql
statements: ALTER TABLE replacements ADD COLUMN lease TEXT
ALTER TABLE replacements ADD COLUMN lease_until INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
ALTER TABLE replacements ADD COLUMN verified_revisions TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'

name: 0013_retired_servers.sql
statements:
CREATE TABLE retired_servers (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  server_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES servers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  connection TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  error TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

name: 0014_candidates.sql
statements: ALTER TABLE servers ADD COLUMN is_candidate INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
UPDATE servers SET is_candidate=1 WHERE id IN (SELECT candidate_id FROM replacements) OR parent_id IN (SELECT candidate_id FROM replacements)

name: 0015_fleet_requests.sql
statements:
CREATE TABLE fleet_requests (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

name: 0016_assistant_tests.sql
statements: CREATE TABLE assistant_settings (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), data TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE assistant_drafts (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, server_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES servers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, expected_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, data TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'proposed', applied_revision INTEGER, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE tunnel_tests (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, source_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES servers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, target_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES servers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, data TEXT NOT NULL, results TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued', error TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, lease TEXT, lease_until INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

name: 0017_team_pages_lab.sql
statements: CREATE TABLE team_members (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('manager','reseller')), enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, salt TEXT NOT NULL, limits TEXT NOT NULL, permissions TEXT NOT NULL, grants TEXT NOT NULL, consumed_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE team_customers (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES team_members(id), server_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES servers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, email TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, quota_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, days INTEGER NOT NULL, ip INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, hwid INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, paused INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_up INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_down INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, consumed_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, identity TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(server_id,email))
CREATE INDEX team_customers_owner ON team_customers(owner_id)
ALTER TABLE team_customers ADD COLUMN poll_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
ALTER TABLE team_customers ADD COLUMN checked_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
CREATE TABLE subscription_pages (server_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES servers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, data TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1)

CREATE TABLE lab_experiments (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, server_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES servers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, name TEXT NOT NULL, data TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'saved', created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

name: 0018_team_archive.sql
statements: ALTER TABLE team_members ADD COLUMN archived INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
ALTER TABLE team_customers ADD COLUMN quota_up INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
ALTER TABLE team_customers ADD COLUMN quota_down INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
ALTER TABLE team_customers ADD COLUMN operation_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
ALTER TABLE team_customers ADD COLUMN operation_until INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0

name: 0019_workspaces.sql
statements: ALTER TABLE team_members ADD COLUMN is_admin INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
ALTER TABLE team_members ADD COLUMN server_scope TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{"all":false,"ids":[]}'
CREATE TABLE workspace_settings (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), owner_path TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE)

name: 0020_checkpoint_cadence.sql
statements: ALTER TABLE managed_state ADD COLUMN checkpoint_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
ALTER TABLE managed_state ADD COLUMN warning TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''

name: 0021_standby_copies.sql
statements:
CREATE TABLE standby_copies (
  target_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES servers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  source_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES servers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  source_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  target_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  phase TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  error TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  checked_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  lease TEXT,
  lease_until INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  CHECK (source_id != target_id)
)
CREATE INDEX standby_source ON standby_copies(source_id)

name: 0022_operation_mode.sql
statements: CREATE TABLE operation_settings (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(mode IN ('manual','automatic')), version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1)
INSERT INTO operation_settings(id,mode) SELECT 1, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM servers) THEN 'automatic' ELSE 'manual' END
ALTER TABLE managed_state ADD COLUMN requested_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
UPDATE managed_state SET requested_revision=revision WHERE phase IN ('pending','applying','running','syncing')

name: 0023_usage_refresh.sql
statements: CREATE TABLE usage_refresh_settings (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), interval_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 60 CHECK(interval_minutes IN (0,15,60,180,360,1440)), version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1)
INSERT INTO usage_refresh_settings(id) VALUES(1)

CREATE TABLE usage_refresh_state (server_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES servers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, attempted_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, refreshed_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, error TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')

name: 0024_outbound_agents.sql
statements:
CREATE TABLE agent_connections (
  server_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES servers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  pairing_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  token_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  last_seen INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(state IN ('pending','connected','revoked'))
)

CREATE TABLE agent_commands (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  server_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agent_connections(server_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  request TEXT NOT NULL,
  response TEXT,
  state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued' CHECK(state IN ('queued','claimed','completed','expired')),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX agent_commands_queue ON agent_commands(server_id,state,created_at)

name: 0025_owner_account.sql
statements:
CREATE TABLE owner_account (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),
  username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  salt TEXT NOT NULL,
  version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  recovery_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE installation_lock (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),
  claim_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

name: 0026_subscription_feedback.sql
statements: ALTER TABLE subscriptions ADD COLUMN rating INTEGER CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5)

CREATE TABLE subscription_sellers (
  owner_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES team_members(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  support TEXT NOT NULL,
  purchase TEXT NOT NULL,
  version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
)
